subtitle: Manage secrets and cross-cluster connections for your agents.
adminRequired: Admin access required. The Agentix.AgentAdmin role is needed to manage connections and secrets.
savedWithOauth: Saved service-account token for {{appId}}. Per-user sign-in is enabled — no client registration needed.
savedOauthNeedsAdmin: Saved service-account token for {{appId}}. For paste-free per-user sign-in, grant the token app-admin on the remote or register a client below.
mintSection: Mint a service-account token (on the target app)
mintHint: The steps and code to mint an OAuth access token are server-version-specific, so follow the remote app's own documentation rather than a snippet here.
mintStep1: Open the remote app's Console (the app whose URL you enter above). In the Links dropdown choose Documentation, then select Topics.
mintStep2: Search for and read these docs by title — depending on the app's server version one or both will be present, and older versions may title them slightly differently:
mintDocSecondary: “Build an OAuth Token API for your Application” — on older versions titled “Obtaining an Access Token” or “Gennerate an Access Token”
mintStep3: Follow them to mint a long-lived access token (grant only the role(s) the agent needs), then paste that token + the remote app's URL into the form above.
addConnectionDesc: Point to a C3 app on another cluster and authenticate with a service-account token minted on that app.
secretsHint: Values are encrypted at rest and only decrypted at runtime for whoever the secret is scoped to.
noSecretsHint: Add your first secret to make it available to your agents and jobs.
confirmRemoveBody: Are you sure you want to remove the secret “{{key}}”? This action cannot be undone.
secretsDesc: Encrypted key/value pairs your agents and jobs read at runtime. Scope decides who can use a secret — Global for everyone, Personal for just you. Adding a secret key with the same name will overwrite the existing value.

mcp.sectionHint: Define shared HTTP MCP servers any agent can use. Users authenticate per-user (OAuth / API key) from the chat composer. HTTP transports only.
mcp.endpointHint: To connect to another C3/Nexus app across clusters, point this at <app-root>/mcp/server and use a personal access token below.
mcp.bearerHint: Sent verbatim as the Authorization header on every request, shared by all users.
mcp.apiKeyHeaderHint: Header the per-user API key is sent in (defaults to X-API-Key). Keys are set per-user in chat.
mcp.oauthOptionalHint: Optional — leave OAuth fields blank to auto-discover them and dynamically register a client on first connect.
mcp.discovered: Filled OAuth settings from the server's metadata.
mcp.discoverEmpty: No OAuth metadata found — fill the fields manually.
mcp.oauthCallback: Finishing sign-in… you can close this window.
mcp.newConnectionAdminOnly: Adding connections requires the Agentix.AgentAdmin role.
mcp.noneUser: No MCP connections available yet. Ask your workspace admin to add one.
mcp.viewForbidden: You don't have permission to view MCP connections. Contact your workspace admin if you need access.
mcp.managedShared: Managed by your workspace admin. Credentials are provided for you — active automatically.
mcp.managedOwnToken: Managed by your workspace admin. The settings are fixed, but you supply your own token below.
mcp.yourCredentialsHint: Set or update your own token for this server, used only for your requests.
mcp.toolsUnavailable: Tool listing not available in this view.
mcp.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete the MCP connection “{{name}}”? This removes the server for everyone it is scoped to and revokes its stored credentials. This cannot be undone.

gate.title: Connect required tools
gate.subtitle: This agent uses MCP connections that need your sign-in before you can chat.

mcp.toolsConnectFirst: Connect to this server to see its available tools.

openHands.title: OpenHands Cloud API key
openHands.desc: OpenHands Cloud conversations run under your own account, so each user supplies their own API key. Save your key here to start OpenHands Cloud chats.
openHands.keyPlaceholder: paste your OpenHands Cloud API key
openHands.hint: Your key is stored encrypted and never shown again. Save a new key to replace it, or clear it to remove it.

serviceTokensDesc: Shared, admin-provisioned tokens. Every cross-cluster call runs as this service account, whichever user triggers it.
oauthClientsDesc: Register a Nexus OAuth client so users can connect a remote app as themselves — no shared token to paste.
registerClientDesc: Enter the remote app URL and the public client id created for Nexus on that app. No secret is stored — sign-in uses PKCE.
redirectUriHint: Use this as the redirect URI when registering the client on the remote app.
autoRegisterClientHint: Have Nexus register the client on the remote using the stored service token — no client ID to paste. Requires the token to have app-admin there.
clientAutoRegistered: Registered OAuth client for {{appUrl}} using the service token.
clientAutoRegisterFailed: Could not auto-register the OAuth client.
registerClientHintTitle: Where does the client ID come from?
registerClientHint: On the remote app, register a public OAuth client for Nexus (via its oauth/register endpoint) and paste the returned client id here. Nexus verifies the app supports OAuth before saving.
clientSaveError: Could not register the OAuth client.
clientClearError: Could not remove the OAuth client.
